A camera/microphone privacy fallback was used; motion sensors may still be readable on this device.

Recommended for blocking “shake” ads. Motion sensors stay blocked for every app, except apps you allow (maps, motion games). When an allowed app is in the foreground, only that app can use sensors. When it leaves, the global block returns.

Sensors stay normal until a blocked app comes to the foreground. Then only Sensor Blocker may read sensors, so the blocked app cannot. This needs fast foreground detection — Accessibility is recommended.

Sensor Blocker uses Accessibility only to see which app moved to the foreground, so it can apply or lift Android SensorService restricted mode immediately. This is optional, but recommended for list-block mode and for quickly restoring the global block after you leave a map or game. It does not read on-screen text, and it does not perform clicks or gestures.

This app needs Shizuku (ADB shell privileges). Root is not required.

1. Install Shizuku from the official GitHub releases: https://github.com/RikkaApps/Shizuku/releases
 Google Play may be hard to use in mainland China; prefer GitHub.
2. On Android 11 or later, enable Developer options → Wireless debugging, then start Shizuku with wireless debugging (follow the pairing steps inside Shizuku).
3. Return here and tap “Authorize Shizuku”.
4. After a reboot, start Shizuku again (wireless debugging is usually off after reboot).

Without a running, authorized Shizuku, this app cannot change SensorService mode.

• This controls motion-sensor access (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer). It is not a general ad blocker; ads that do not use those sensors will still appear.
• It uses the public Android SensorService restricted mode (dumpsys sensorservice restrict). Some OEMs change or hide this service; it is not guaranteed on every device.
• A reboot usually clears restricted mode. If monitoring is on, the app will try to re-apply it after boot once Shizuku is running again.
• If you allowlist nothing in Global mode, navigation compass and motion games will not work until you allow those apps.
• Shizuku or wireless debugging is required. This app does not need root, Xposed, or a VPN / MITM proxy.
